outcome: A failed job is retried on an increasing backoff rather than immediately.

acceptance_criteria.text: A job with attempts remaining is retried once its backoff has elapsed.

expected_verification.assertion: a job whose backoff has elapsed is retried

acceptance_criteria.text: A job is never retried sooner than its backoff allows, whatever timestamp it carries.

expected_verification.assertion: a job whose failed_at is ahead of the current clock is not retried immediately

data_impact: None. Retry decisions are computed from a job record.
security_impact: None directly. An immediate retry loop is a denial-of-service against the job's own downstream.
